messages:
maria: Quick postmortem follow-up: we dug into the delayed-ingest window from 2026-03-01 02:00 UTC and saw token counters queued but not emitted for ~42 minutes. Need an action list with clear owners + acceptance criteria.
liam: On it. I can take the ingestion fix and the backfill job. Will need DB export access and a dry-run window.
sophia: I'll take customer comms + credit approvals. Finance needs the impact CSV and a short blurb for customers.
james: Legal wants neutral language; ops wants any mitigation to be non-disruptive. Also want the ledger impact for month-end.
maria: Draft actions below — please edit owner/ETA/AC.
```
ACTIONS: (fill owner, ETA, AC)
1) Investigate root cause of emitter stall (owner: liam) - ETA 2026-03-12 - AC: postmortem paragraph + root cause PR linked.
2) Hotfix: restart/patch emitter backpressure handling (owner: liam) - ETA 2026-03-11 - AC: deployment passed canary 2h, no lost tokens.
3) Backfill recount job for affected window (owner: liam) - ETA dry-run 2026-03-13, full run 2026-03-14 - AC: reconciled CSV + checksum diff <0.5% or escalation.
4) Customer credits & email (owner: sophia) - ETA 2026-03-16 - AC: template signed off by legal + ledger CSV uploaded to billing system.
5) Add ingestion-lag metric and alert with sample lineage (owner: maria) - ETA 2026-03-12 - AC: alert fires in staging and has runbook link.
6) Weekly anomaly report for 8 weeks (owner: james) - ETA first report 2026-03-20 - AC: report includes count deltas, source partitions, and compaction overlap.
7) Long-term: change compaction schedule or add per-partition windowing (owner: infra-team) - ETA proposal 2026-03-25 - AC: design doc + rollout plan.
```
liam: Added note: backfill will touch billing tables; we'll snapshot ledgers before any credits. I request a quick freeze window for writes during full run (2h).
sophia: Understood. I'll coordinate with finance for freeze and prepare the refund logic. Also proposing: thresholds for auto-credit (eg delta > $1 or >5% of invoice). Thoughts?
james: Auto-credit thresholds sound fine but need manual sign-off for >$5k. We'll add that to the process.
billing-bot: Heads-up: scheduled snapshot job windows available 2026-03-14 01:00-04:00 UTC and 2026-03-15 01:00-04:00 UTC. Use ticket #BILL-342 to reserve.
maria: Good. For monitoring, let's capture compaction start/end timestamps and ingest rates, then correlate with lag spikes. Add to weekly report.
liam: I opened PR #461 on the emitter fix and labelled it 'hotfix/critical'. Deploy plan: canary to 10% traffic for 2h, then 100% if ok.
sophia: I'll draft the customer note once liam posts dry-run CSV. Template will include: scope, dates, amount range, and next steps. Legal review requested before send.
james: Add audit trail: every invoice adjustment must reference the backfill CSV checksum and the ticket. Finance will store in GL notes.
maria: I'll create a lightweight tracker (Google Sheet) with columns: action, owner, ETA, AC, PR/Ticket, status. I'll post link here.
maria: Tracker: https://docs.example/s/billing-remediation-tracker (shared with finance & infra).
liam: Can someone grant me DB read access to billing_summaries-prod? I need it for the dry-run. 
sophia: @infra-team please grant liam read-only. Also looping @finance to confirm freeze window.
james: Finance OK for freeze 2026-03-14 01:00-03:00 UTC. Please minimise user-impact.
maria: Thanks. We'll reconvene after dry-run. Everyone, add any follow-ups in the tracker rather than thread. Closing but will update with dry-run outputs. :white_check_mark:
